source_refs.note: Topic 2.9.1.2 Finally and Else (PDF 61, printed 58). The printed code is scrambled across columns; the lesson reconstructs it from the explanation. Flagged.

blocks.text: The finally block always runs, whether or not an exception was raised. The else block runs only if no exception was raised in the try block.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)

blocks.prompt: What is printed if the user types abc?
blocks.explanation: "Invalid input! Please enter a valid number." and then "Execution completed."

items: else: runs when there is no error; finally: always runs (clean-up, completion message).
